security_audit.summary: The static command-execution findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code formatting. The hardcoded URLs are public ApeWorX and Ape documentation references, and no prompt injection, credential access, or data exfiltration intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Documentation instructions require network access to fetch current external docs.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the URL list limited to trusted official documentation and ask the user before fetching external pages in restricted environments.

remediation.issue: The skill covers live DeFi trading workflows where user funds may be at risk.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before any live swap and recommend small test swaps for new routes or large trades.

content.value_statement: Uniswap development often requires current SDK knowledge, token setup, and careful trade validation. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Ape-based pricing, routing, swaps, and bot integration.
actual_capabilities: Fetches current uniswap-sdk, Ape, and ape-tokens documentation before drafting code.
Helps identify the target network, tokens, and desired Uniswap action.
Guides price queries, route searches, and swap preparation with uniswap-sdk.
Explains token list setup and pair indexing with Ape and ape-tokens.
Supports Silverback bot integration for Uniswap workflows.
Promotes price checks and small test swaps before live trading.
limitations: Requires Python, Ape, configured Ape accounts, and token list setup.
Depends on external documentation pages for current implementation details.
Does not remove financial risk from swaps, routing, slippage, or liquidity changes.
Does not provide audited smart contract or investment advice.

use_cases.title: Prototype Uniswap Scripts
use_cases.description: Draft Ape-based scripts for token prices, route discovery, and swap preparation.

use_cases.title: Prepare Safer Trade Flows
use_cases.description: Add price checks, user confirmation, and small test trades before larger swaps.

use_cases.title: Integrate Silverback Bots
use_cases.description: Use uniswap-sdk guidance when adding Uniswap routing and liquidity indexing to bots.

prompt_templates.title: Check Setup Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Uniswap skill to list the Ape, account, token list, and documentation checks needed before I write a Python script.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Price Query
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Uniswap skill to help me query a token price on [network] for [token pair] with Ape and uniswap-sdk.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Swap Route
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Uniswap skill to plan a route from [token in] to [token out] on [network], including likely intermediate tokens and safety checks.

prompt_templates.title: Design Bot Integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Uniswap skill to outline a Silverback bot workflow that indexes pairs, checks liquidity, and prepares confirmed swaps.

output_examples.input: I need to get the USDC price for WETH on mainnet.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies the target network and token pair, fetches current docs, then outlines an Ape workflow for indexing pairs and querying price before any trade.

output_examples.input: Help me swap a large token amount through Uniswap.
output_examples.output: The assistant first plans a price check, route review, slippage discussion, explicit confirmation, and a small test swap before proposing a larger live transaction.

output_examples.input: I want a Silverback bot that tracks Uniswap liquidity.
output_examples.output: The assistant summarizes the Silverback integration path, pair indexing needs, token list setup, and route monitoring behavior described by the SDK documentation.

best_practices: Fetch the current ApeWorX and Ape documentation before drafting implementation details.
Confirm the network, token addresses, amount, and route assumptions before any live transaction.
Start with read-only price queries and small test swaps before larger automated trades.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on stale SDK knowledge when the skill requests current documentation.
Do not execute live swaps without explicit user approval and route review.
Do not write custom Uniswap routing logic when the SDK already handles indexing and routes.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build Python workflows for Uniswap pricing, routing, swaps, and Silverback bot integration using Ape.

faq.question: Does this skill execute trades by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance for writing workflows and should require user approval before any live trade.

faq.question: Why does the skill fetch documentation?
faq.answer: It asks the assistant to use current ApeWorX and Ape documentation so generated guidance matches the latest SDK behavior.

faq.question: What tools are required?
faq.answer: The workflow expects Python, Ape, configured Ape accounts, token lists, and the uniswap-sdk package.

faq.question: Can it help with Silverback bots?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes guidance for using uniswap-sdk inside Silverback bot workflows.

faq.question: Is this financial advice?
faq.answer: No. It is developer guidance for protocol interaction and does not assess investment decisions.
